cover.sub: WHAT RESETS · WHAT YOU KEEP · REWARDS

slides.title: HIT LEVEL 55
rules: Finish Level 55, then the last tile lets you enter Prestige.
You pick Classic or Regular again at every new Prestige.

slides.title: CLASSIC PRESTIGE
rules: Your level unlocks and Create‑a‑Class progress.
+20% XP, 1 Permanent Unlock Token, bonus rewards.

slides.title: REGULAR PRESTIGE
rules: Only your level: back to Level 1.
All your unlocked content. No token, no Classic bonus rewards.

slides.title: UNLOCK TOKEN
rules: The item you pick stays unlocked at every level and Prestige.
Career › Progression › Multiplayer Level Unlocks › Spend Token.

slides.title: PRESTIGE MASTER
rules: Paragon skin for Park and an orange Level Color.
Every 5–10 levels up to 99, then every 25 levels.

slides.title: PRESTIGE LEGEND
rules: Prestige Master weapon camo and 6 more rewards.

source: Tier 1: callofduty.com 'Ready for Launch: Modern Warfare 4 Progression and Prestige' (19.10.2026): 10 Prestige levels + 1,000 Prestige Master levels, Classic + Regular paths, Prestige Master rewards every 5-10 levels to 99 then every 25 to 1,000 (Prestige Legend), Paragon skin for Park + Orange Level Color instant; Activision Support 'Prestige in Modern Warfare 4' (10.11.2026): enter Prestige via the final tile after Level 55, Career menu, Permanent Unlock Tokens not with Regular Prestige, spend via Career > Progression > Multiplayer Level Unlocks > Spend Permanent Unlock Token, 55 levels per Prestige with a reward every 10 levels, Prestige Legend = 8 rewards incl. Ju Kwon Operator Skin + Prestige Master Weapon Camo; official @CallofDuty post 19.10.2026 (Classic: resets Level Unlocks + Create-a-Class progress for 20% XP boost, Permanent Unlock Token, bonus cosmetic rewards; Regular: restart at Level 1 keeping unlocked content). Tier 2: IGN, conquestcapped (Prestige 1 instant Sandstorm skin), esports.gg, overgear (Prime variants on Classic).

caption:
MW4 prestige explained 🔥 How Prestige works in Modern Warfare 4: hit Level 55, then pick Classic Prestige (resets unlocks + Create-a-Class for +20% XP, a Permanent Unlock Token and bonus rewards) or Regular Prestige (back to Level 1, keep everything). After all 10 Prestige levels comes Prestige Master up to Level 1,000 with the Paragon and Ju Kwon skins. Classic or Regular? Comment below 👇 Save this & send it to your squad!
